records.source: I came here once when I was a kid... The only thing I remember is getting sick on the bus ride.
records.translation: 小時候我來過這裡一次……唯一的印象就是搭公車時吐了。

records.source: Mom, I'm bored!
records.translation: 媽媽，我好無聊！

records.source: Ah, nothing like the smell o' grilled shrimp on a warm day.
records.translation: 啊，溫暖的日子裡，沒有什麼比烤蝦香味更棒了。

records.source: Cactus Man: They're feeling shy right now. Come back later.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：它們現在有點害羞，晚點再來。

records.source: Cactus Man: So, how's the little guy doing?
records.translation: 仙人掌人：那麼，小傢伙過得如何？

records.source: Cactus Man: Ah, yes... You look like someone who would appreciate what I'm offering.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：啊，沒錯……你看起來懂得欣賞我所提供的東西。

records.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... I've got the perfect match for you.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：噢，沒錯……我有一個最適合你的夥伴。

records.source: Cactus Man: That look in your eye... it says: "I need a cactus, or I'm gonna burst".
records.translation: 仙人掌人：你眼中的神情……分明在說：「我需要一盆仙人掌，不然就要爆炸了。」

records.source: Cactus Man: Are you ready to welcome a new cactus into your life?
records.translation: 仙人掌人：準備好迎接一盆新仙人掌進入你的生命了嗎？

records.source: Cactus Man: I understand. They may be small, but accepting a cactus into your life is big responsibility. Come back when you're feeling ready.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：我明白。它們雖然小，但接納一盆仙人掌進入生命可是重大責任。準備好後再回來吧。

records.source: Cactus Man: Great. Let's see...
records.translation: 仙人掌人：太好了。讓我看看……

records.source: Cactus Man: You don't have enough space... Come back after you've made some room.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：你的空間不夠……騰出一些位置後再回來。

records.source: Cactus Man: Yes, he bears a striking resemblance to you, don't you agree?
records.translation: 仙人掌人：沒錯，它和你長得驚人地相似，你不覺得嗎？

records.source: Cactus Man: This one's a little shy, but I know you'll become friends in no time.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：這一盆有點害羞，但我知道你們很快就會成為朋友。

records.source: Cactus Man: Oh, yes... it's a match made in heaven.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：噢，沒錯……真是天作之合。

records.source: Cactus Man: I won't say why... but this one is the perfect match for you.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：原因我就不說了……但這一盆最適合你。

records.source: Cactus Man: This one's got a strange look, but it suits you.
records.translation: 仙人掌人：這一盆長得有點奇怪，但很適合你。

records.source: The shop isn't open. Come back later.
records.translation: 商店尚未營業，晚點再來。

records.source: Accept
records.translation: 接受

records.source: Decline
records.translation: 拒絕

records.source: Willy's Challenge: Catch 3 Sandfish.
records.translation: 威利的挑戰：捕捉 3 條沙魚。

records.source: Willy's Challenge
records.translation: 威利的挑戰

records.source: Willy has challenged you to catch 3 Sandfish.
records.translation: 威利向你發出挑戰，要你捕捉 3 條沙魚。

records.source: Ah, you got 'em. An exciting catch, aren't they?#$b#Here's 25 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: 啊，你抓到了。釣起來很刺激，對吧？#$b#這 25 顆卡利科蛋是給你的獎勵。

records.source: Willy has challenged you to catch a Scorpion Carp.
records.translation: 威利向你發出挑戰，要你捕捉一條蠍鯉。

records.source: Ah, you did it. A challenging catch, don't you think?#$b#Here's 50 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: 啊，你辦到了。釣起來很有挑戰性，對吧？#$b#這 50 顆卡利科蛋是給你的獎勵。

records.source: Willy has challenged you to find a "Golden Bobber".
records.translation: 威利向你發出挑戰，要你找到「金色浮標」。

records.source: Well, if it isn't me favorite golden bobber!#$b#And it only smells mild o' fish... Heh heh.$h#$b#Here's 30 Calico Eggs for your reward.
records.translation: 哎呀，這不是我最愛的金色浮標嗎！#$b#而且魚腥味只有一點點……嘿嘿。$h#$b#這 30 顆卡利科蛋是給你的獎勵。

records.source: Willy's Challenge: Catch a Scorpion Carp.
records.translation: 威利的挑戰：捕捉一條蠍鯉。

records.source: Willy: A fish swallowed me rare golden bobber! There's 30 eggs for whoever returns it.
records.translation: 威利：有條魚吞了我珍貴的金色浮標！誰能歸還，就能獲得 30 顆蛋。

records.source: Find and return Willy's Golden Bobber.
records.translation: 找到威利的金色浮標並歸還。

records.source: Scholar: Forgive me, friend. But I cannot engage with you until the festival is open.
records.translation: 學者：請原諒，朋友。節慶開放前，我無法與你進行挑戰。

records.source: Scholar: Greetings, friend! Care for a test of knowledge? If you can answer my questions correctly, you'll earn a prize. What do you say?
records.translation: 學者：你好，朋友！想接受知識考驗嗎？只要答對我的問題，就能獲得獎品。意下如何？

records.source: Scholar: Excellent! Now, for the first question...
records.translation: 學者：太好了！現在，第一題……

records.source: Scholar: Correct!
records.translation: 學者：答對了！

records.source: Scholar: Very Good! I'm impressed with your knowledge, friend. Here is your prize.
records.translation: 學者：非常好！朋友，你的知識令我佩服。這是你的獎品。

records.source: Scholar: Wrong! ...I'm sorry, friend. But you will have to come back another time.
records.translation: 學者：答錯了！……很抱歉，朋友。你得改天再來。

records.source: Scholar: ...I'm sorry, friend. But you will have to come back next time.
records.translation: 學者：……很抱歉，朋友。你得下次再來。

records.source: Scholar: Enjoy the eggs, my friend. I'll be back next year for another challenge.
records.translation: 學者：好好享用這些蛋吧，朋友。明年我會再來舉辦另一場挑戰。

records.translation: 問題 1：每個季節在哪一天結束？

records.source: 28th,30th,31st,26th
records.translation: 第 28 日,第 30 日,第 31 日,第 26 日
